statement: Bounded Option-5 rung-5 owner slice: src/bootstrap/system-partition-classification.js declares and exports the exact frozen bootstrap-critical, priority-control-plane, and default vocabulary, one frozen ordered row table, and classifySystemPartition with row-preferred identity, original-options table resolution, and frozen overlap facts; legacy isSystemTablePartition and isPriorityControlPlanePartition delegate without behavior change, including top-level fallback when a row ID is unparsable. A decision-table-v1 JSON exhaustively pins bootstrap-critical precedence over priority overlap, and focused runtime tests independently compare legacy booleans across valid, absent, row-precedence, and unparsable-row inputs. doneWhen: bounded evidence reports metric at most 119, the owner check passed, and every gate green. NOT in scope: migrating consumers, changing table-id parsing, critical-transport classification, admission subclasses, numeric budgets, or behavior.
